text_block_list.text:
My three years with Tanino Gimlet came to 
an end, and after a little time had 
passed――――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――OOAAAAHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. That was a truly powerful run, Top 
Road. Thanks to you, my divine protection 
has grown even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! Running alongside you was 
incredibly thrilling for me, too, 
Gimlet-san!

...Tanino Gimlet continues to work 
tirelessly today, preparing for her next 
challenge.

Lately, as if they were naturally on the 
same wavelength, she often trained 
alongside the experienced veteran, Narita 
Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Has the next race already been decided?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us go with the flow, then. Depending 
on where destiny leads, our paths may very 
well cross again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I'm looking forward to 
it! I've... always wanted to repay 
Gimlet-san someday.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Oh? That's news to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That was the first time I've ever 
said that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since we ran together in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) during your Classic year... 
I've watched all of your races, 
Gimlet-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The way you shattered common sense when 
you ran, how you never feared any race... 
It was so passionate, and so breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When I felt my own limits, you told me, 
'Limits are meant to be broken.' 'I can 
still run even further'—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what they made me realize.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I can still keep running 
today— I believe it's all thanks to you, 
Gimlet-san!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. This must be itâthe power of 
the "God of Destruction"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I am the "God of Destruction." To 
everyone…… and to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Please allow me to repay this kindness 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I, too, look forward to that 
time, Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...The fact that we can talk like this, 
looking toward the place we'll someday 
reach, might just be a miracle in itself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A miracle—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah. Truly sweet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Time flows ever onward. Where there is a 
beginning, there is also an end.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember that conversation we 
had earlier about Top Road?
choice_data_list:
"The reason I can still run today is..." 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing those words reminded me all 
over again."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can run right now is— 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: That it's all thanks to you, you see.
Oryaaaaaaaahhh!!! Yaaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... That was definitely me just 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Don't be ridiculous...! It 
was totally me, no doubt about it...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say!? Wanna go another 
round!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!! This time I'm gonna leave 
you behind by more than a full length so 
there's no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—And now, a brand-new layer of chaos is 
about to crash down upon my future.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor this miracle together. ...As 
many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh— Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because the one who can intoxicate you 
the most is none other than myself."
